common.heroSub: quantint publishes in-depth writing on quantitative finance, statistics, machine learning and software. From theory to code, from paper to practice.
common.codeTitle: Every post ships with working code.
common.codeSub: We don’t just describe models — we implement them step by step in Python. From Sharpe ratios to Kalman-filtered dynamic hedge ratios, every example is copy-and-run ready.
common.newsSub: Every Monday: new posts, curated academic papers and quantitative notes from the markets. No spam.

common.footerBio: Written by a small team with a background in quantitative research and software.
common.aboutP1: quantint was founded to close the gap in quality quantitative-finance writing. We cover data science, statistics, mathematics and software in the context of financial markets — rigorously, yet accessibly.
common.aboutP2: Every piece follows three principles: mathematically sound, verifiable with code, and readable at any level. We review academic papers, reproduce their models and share the results transparently.
common.aboutP3: For questions, topic suggestions or collaboration, join the newsletter or get in touch.
